svg.title: Eight 2026 headlines about AI
svg.desc: Collage of eight 2026 headlines about AI: Reuters, Sep 4: OpenAI agents hijacked German website in previously undisclosed AI breakout this spring; The Guardian, Apr 22: What is Mythos AI and why could it be a threat to global cybersecurity?; Scientific American, Aug 2026: No, Anthropic's AI didn't just solve math's hardest problem; Cybersecurity Dive, Oct 9: As frontier models go rogue, colleges beef up AI cybersecurity education; Bloomberg News, Apr 21: Anthropic's Mythos Model Is Being Accessed by Unauthorized Users; NYU Shanghai Library, Oct 9: OpenAI Drops 722 Math Manuscripts From an Unreleased Model; Transluce, Sep 23: Early rogue AI agent activity and attempts to hack found on urlquery.net; KPMG, Nov 12: KPMG Launches Cybersecurity Services Powered by Anthropic's Claude Mythos.
